title: Review queue fluent APIs must be guarded on Databricks tracking URIs
answers: review queue call returns INTERNAL_ERROR Not Found on Databricks
list_review_queues fails with RestException Not Found on databricks tracking uri
create_review_queue returns HTTP 500 on Databricks workspace
mlflow.genai.review_queues not supported in Databricks environments
body:
Symptom: On a Databricks tracking URI, calling mlflow.genai.review_queues functions (e.g. list_review_queues, create_review_queue) fails with a generic "RestException: INTERNAL_ERROR: Not Found" (HTTP 500) that looks like a server outage.
Root cause: mlflow/genai/review_queues/__init__.py public fluent functions had no Databricks guard, so calls fell through to the OSS /api/3.0/mlflow/review-queues/* routes, which are not implemented on Databricks.
Fix pattern: Decorate each public review_queues function with @databricks_api_disabled("<function_name>", _REVIEWS_UI_ALTERNATIVE), placed directly under @experimental so the guard runs before any TracingClient construction. The same decorator is used by the sibling mlflow.genai.label_schemas APIs.
Constraints: Applies to the public fluent functions in mlflow/genai/review_queues/__init__.py only; the TracingClient-level methods are not decorated. The guard must fire before any client or network work, so it behaves the same whether or not the workspace preview is enabled.
applies: Any public function added to or changed in mlflow/genai/review_queues/__init__.py that routes to the OSS tracking API.
says: Creating or listing review queues in a cloud workspace throws an internal server error
Review queue operations fail with a not found error against the managed tracking server
Review queues show a generic outage failure instead of explaining they are unsupported
Make review queue requests give a clear unsupported message on workspace tracking servers
search: Public fluent functions in mlflow/genai/review_queues/__init__.py must be decorated with @databricks_api_disabled directly under @experimental to block calls on Databricks tracking URIs before TracingClient construction. This guard prevents generic HTTP 500 and RestException Not Found errors when routing to unimplemented OSS /api/3.0/mlflow/review-queues/* endpoints. The requirement applies only to public fluent functions in mlflow/genai/review_queues/__init__.py, not to TracingClient methods, and mirrors mlflow.genai.label_schemas.
